title: Spin the Hour Hand 1, 2, 3… 20 Hours: Where Does It Stop? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
The hour hand points to 3. Move it 1 hour, then 2, then 3... all the way to 20. Where does it stop?
See two ways to solve it without spinning a clock, and then try a new one yourself!
A kid-friendly AMC 8-style Level 4 problem with Vantee.
